submitted.title: Add React Bits backgrounds with Topography as default
submitted.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Add Standard, Topography, Magic Rings, Lightfall and Ghost Fibers to Appearance with Preview, Apply, Cancel and Reset. Topography is the default when no background is saved. Keep explicit selections and other existing settings across restarts.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-045 and WI-046 for preferences and session handling. Integrate with WI-052's shell.

**Verify** · Verify each effect and its static fallback, saved settings for two members and after a port-changing restart, motion preferences, Solid and Glass contrast and interaction layering. Verify switching effects releases the previous resources.

**Delivery** · v0.2 client, existing PR #9.
